trap.see: The clock is frozen, so two of its neighbours must go first; one of the neighbours that can melt it is locked (it needs the keys): do not take the free key early: it would sit in the tray through the whole dig.
trap.uiNote: obKind() shows one overlay per tile (ice, else lock, else key): a tile that is both frozen and a key (or locked) would hide the key (or lock) badge, so it is never built; the chain freezes the key COVER, a way tile or a thaw-neighbour instead.

dennis.note: I like to see this way of stacking more. You see things better. The trap is too easy you can think about it better and make it smarter or a bit more tray pressure.
